wilsonMaraRoundTrip.confidenceNote: MATERIAL DISCREPANCY, broader than the single Mara-Amboseli gap already flagged in flights-amboseli-mara-nanyuki-2026.json. On Wilson-Mara one-way, contract letter ($185/$145) is $5-15 HIGHER than xlsx ($180/$139 high season, $170/$132 low season) depending on season. On the return, contract letter ($285/$225) is likewise higher than both xlsx seasonal figures ($280/$214 high, $265/$203 low). This is not just a Mara-Amboseli-specific gap - the two Airvan documents disagree on nearly every shared route, with the xlsx being season-differentiated and cheaper, and the contract letter being flat and higher. Per the existing convention (see flights-amboseli-mara-nanyuki-2026.json note), the signed contract-letter PDF figures are treated as the more authoritative source for Sunworld's actual contracted rate, but this should be confirmed with Airvan/Sunworld directly before relying on either figure for a quote outside the original Amboseli/Mara/Nanyuki itinerary this was first extracted for.
